'''Opula Deget''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Opera/Legends|opera]] [[Musician/Legends|singer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Courscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A woman who enjoyed spreading scandals about her rivals, it was rumored she removed the headlining [[Unidentified Galaxies Opera House headliner|star]] of Coruscant's [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]] from the limelight. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], Deget visited the opera house, walking up the house's stairs whilst holding hands with the Human [[Ulfor Bombaasa/Legends|Ulfor Bombaasa]].

==Biography==
[[File:Bombaasa.png|thumb|250px|Opula Deget walked up the stairs of the Galaxies Opera House with Ulfor Bombaasa.]]
Opula Deget was a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="Starship" /> [[Gender/Legends|female]] up-and-coming<ref name="db" /> [[Opera/Legends|opera]]<ref name="Starship" /> [[Musician/Legends|singer]] active on<ref name="db" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="db" /> a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref> that lasted from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Clone">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates {{Film|II}}, which includes the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|start]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] and dates {{Film|III}}, which includes the [[Mission to Mustafar/Legends|end]] of the Clone Wars, to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Backstage gossip<ref name="Chronicles">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> stated that it was Deget who told the media the scandalous story that removed the former headlining [[Unidentified Galaxies Opera House headliner|star]] of the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]],<ref name="db" /> in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]],<ref name="Chronicles" /> from the limelight.<ref name="db" /> 

In 19 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|BBY]],<ref name="Clone" /> Deget visited the opera house during the<ref name="Episode 3" /> [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] ballet performance ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]''.<ref name="SquidLake">{{CSWECite|III|185|''Squid Lake''}}</ref> She walked up the house's stairs, holding hands with the fellow Human<ref name="Episode 3" /> [[Ulfor Bombaasa/Legends|Ulfor Bombaasa]],<ref name="DaG" /> when the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran by to attend his meeting with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].<ref name="Episode 3" />

==Personality and traits==
Deget had [[Color/Legends|gold]] skin and brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="db" /> She took pleasure in spreading scandalous stories about her rivals to the press, thereby ruining their careers.<ref name="Starship" />

==Skills and abilities==
The singer was seen as an up-and-coming talent.<ref name="Chronicles" />

==Equipment==
While at the opera house, she wore a gold and black [[Clothing/Legends|gown]] with black gloves and a black headpiece.<ref name="DaG">''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Opula Deget first appeared, portrayed by an uncredited extra, in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'']],<ref name="Episode 3" /> which premiered on [[May 19]], [[2005]].<ref name="Year by year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, Updated and Expanded Edition]]''</ref> The opera house scenes featuring the character were filmed at [[Shepperton Studios]] as part of additional photography on [[August 23]], [[2004]].<ref name="MakingOf">''[[The Making of Star Wars Revenge of the Sith]]''</ref> Deget was first identified in the reference book ''[[Dressing a Galaxy: The Costumes of Star Wars]]'', written by [[Trisha Biggar]]<ref name="DaG" /> and released on [[October 11]], 2005.<ref name="DressingDate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.waterstones.com/book/dressing-a-galaxy-part-1/trisha-biggar/george-lucas/9780810959644|text=Dressing a Galaxy: Part 1: The Costumes of Star Wars (Hardback)|work=[[Wikipedia:Waterstones|Waterstones]]|archivedate=20260701041521}}</ref>
